fusions.name: Palmed Barb
fusions.desc: Flicks a barbed pin that deals 8 damage to an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, uses that affliction up and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Swing and Snatch
fusions.desc: Swings across up to 6 tiles to the target, then strikes it for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Lifted Purse
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
